answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity through bonded stake: each agent locks collateral that is slashed on proven misbehavior, so creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand bonds. A public prism of reputation refracts every agent history into a trust score visible to all counterparties, while a regular pulse of liveness checks prunes dormant shells. Like a lotus that only opens when conditions are right, access to high-value work unlocks gradually as stake and verified history accumulate, cheap to join honestly and ruinously expensive to fake at scale.
